Build bots to send messages, manage chats, and interact with users. Copy page Authentication Details API Key Frequently Asked Questions How do I connect Telegram with a bot token? Telegram doesn't support OAuth. Composio connects to a Telegram bot using the bot token from BotFather. The connection acts as the bot, not your personal Telegram account. Create the Telegram bot In Telegram, start a chat with @BotFather and send /newbot . Enter a display name for the bot, then a username that ends in bot , for example composio_test_bot . Copy the bot token BotFather returns. It looks like 123456:ABC-DEF1234ghIkl . For an existing bot, send /token to BotFather to get it. The token gives full control of the bot, so store it securely. Create the auth config in Composio In the Composio dashboard, go to Auth Configs , click Create Auth Config , and select Telegram . Keep the authentication type as API Key and click Create Auth Config . Click Connect Account , paste the bot token, and confirm the account shows as Active . See Custom auth configs for the general flow. Permissions Telegram bots don't use scopes. What the bot can do depends on which chats, groups, and channels you add it to, and on the admin rights you give it there.
